prompt.en: Your school is organizing a 'Fitness Fiesta Week' (yoga sessions, a healthy cooking competition, fitness quizzes) from October 12 to October 16. As the Health Club Secretary, draft a notice inviting participation. (Word limit: 50 words)

label.en: Signed off with a name and designation
Names at least one of the announced activities

level1.en: Mention what students will actually do that week.

clue.en: Yoga sessions, a cooking competition, or fitness quizzes.

level2Template.en: The week includes yoga sessions and a healthy ___ competition.
Fitness Fiesta Week runs from October 12 to October ___.

explanation.en:
NOTICE

Fitness Fiesta Week
12 October 2025

All students are invited to participate in Fitness Fiesta Week, to be held from 12 to 16 October. The week includes daily yoga sessions, a healthy cooking competition, and fitness quizzes for all age groups. Interested students should register with the Health Club by 10 October.

Riya Sharma
Health Club Secretary
